items.followUp: Why is ROM called non-volatile memory?

rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying RAM as volatile memory.

rubric.why: Explains that RAM does not retain its contents when power is removed.
rubric.description: States that data is lost when power is switched off.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that RAM's stored data is lost without power.

modelAnswer: RAM is called volatile memory because it stores data temporarily.
Its contents are lost when the power is switched off.
